title: On questions of Pogorelov and Toponogov
summary: We give explicit counterexamples to two questions. One is asked by Pogorelov and the other is by Toponogov. These questions concern the existence of closed asymptotic curves in a saddle surface, namely a complete immersed regular surface in $\mathbb{R}^3$ with nonpositive Gaussian/sectional curvature, and its geometric consequences under some topological conditions. We also modify the statements and prove a corrected version. In the appendix we include an example clarifying a conjecture of Milnor.
